summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs is reportedly moving toward revoking the 2001 maritime MoU with Cambodia. Officials argue that since Cambodia joined the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) in February 2026, a 'new legal reality' exists. Thailand intends to shift away from bilateral negotiations toward this international legal framework to resolve the long-standing deadlock over the 26,000-square-kilometer Overlapping Claims Area.

summary: The Philippines has offered to facilitate dialogue between Thailand and Cambodia to ease growing tensions. A potential trilateral meeting between the leaders of Thailand, Cambodia, and the Philippines may take place during the 48th ASEAN Summit in Cebu from May 6 to 8. This move aims to rebuild confidence between the two neighbors as they navigate disagreements over maritime boundaries and domestic political pressure.

summary: Deputy Prime Minister Prak Sokhonn announced that Cambodia will use international law and peaceful mechanisms to handle maritime disputes if Thailand unilaterally cancels the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). He stated that the MoU is currently the only shared framework for managing overlapping claims in the Gulf of Thailand and its removal would force Cambodia to explore other legal avenues to protect its sovereignty.

summary: Thai authorities at the Khlong Luek border checkpoint repatriated 55 Cambodian migrant workers (34 men, 19 women, and 2 boys) after their legal cases were finalized. summary: Acting Head of State Hun Sen warned that Thailand's push to cancel the 2001 maritime MoU (MOU 44) could dismantle the long-standing bilateral framework for managing overlapping claims in the Gulf of Thailand. Citing Thai security experts, he suggested the move is driven by nationalism and questioned if it is an attempt to 'internationalize' the dispute. He expressed respect for Thai analysts who oppose the cancellation and warned that moving away from bilateral talks could complicate future negotiations.

summary: Cambodian analysts have rejected claims made by the Thai Ambassador to the UN regarding historical assistance to Cambodia. They argue that Thailand is using past aid, including $17 million in technical assistance since COVID-19, to justify current 'aggression' and violations of sovereignty. The report highlights that thousands of Cambodian households remain displaced near the border due to Thai blockades and explosive remnants of war.

summary: Phnom Penh has warned it will shift from bilateral negotiations to international legal mechanisms under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) if Thailand unilaterally withdraws from the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding. summary: Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn announced that Cambodia will trigger a 'compulsory conciliation' process under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). This comes after the Thai Cabinet officially voted to cancel the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MoU 44) regarding overlapping maritime claims. Cambodia expressed 'deep regret,' stating the MoU was the only bilateral framework for peaceful negotiation and that Thailand's withdrawal undermines the spirit of cooperation.

summary: Cambodian Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn stated that Phnom Penh has 'no option' but to trigger the compulsory conciliation mechanism under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). summary: Following a trilateral summit in Cebu with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Cambodia and Thailand have agreed to use the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to resolve maritime disputes in the Overlapping Claims Area (OCA). A high-ranking Cambodian official confirmed that Thailand acknowledged Cambodia's diplomatic note from May 6, which initiated compulsory conciliation after Bangkok unilaterally scrapped the 2001 MoU on maritime claims. However, Cambodia notes it has yet to receive a formal notification from Thailand regarding the MoU termination under the Vienna Convention.

summary: Following the ASEAN Summit in Cebu, Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul and Cambodian PM Hun Manet confirmed they are adhering to the 2025 Joint Statement on a ceasefire. summary: The Cambodian Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts has strongly condemned Thailand's unilateral decision to register several ancient border temples—including Tamone, Ta Krabei, and K'nar temples—as Thai national monuments. summary: An in-depth commentary published by Fresh News sharply criticized Thailand's Fine Arts Department for registering the Ta Moan temple complex, Ta Krabey Temple, and K'nar Temple as Thai ancient monuments. summary: The Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts of Cambodia issued a strong protest and categorical rejection regarding Thailand's organization of public events, religious ceremonies, and opening of K'nar Temple for mass public visitation. Cambodia maintains that K'nar Temple, alongside Tamone Thom and Ta Krabey, is located entirely within its sovereign territory according to the 1904 and 1907 Franco-Siamese Treaties. The ministry characterized Thailand's actions as an unlawful attempt to create a 'fait accompli' on the ground to back up its occupation by force, declaring these activities null, void, and without legal effect under international law.

summary: Following Thailand's unilateral termination of the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding regarding overlapping maritime claims in the Gulf of Thailand on May 5, 2026, reports have surfaced of heightened Thai naval presence, patrols, and provocative military activities in disputed waters. summaryKh: បន្ទាប់ពីប្រទេសថៃបានសម្រេចលុបចោលអនុស្សរណៈនៃការយោគយល់គ្នា (MOU) ឆ្នាំ 2001 ជាឯកតោភាគី ពាក់ព័ន្ធនឹងតំបន់ទាមទារត្រួតស៊ីគ្នានៅឈូងសមុទ្រថៃ កាលពីថ្ងៃទី 5 ឧសភា ឆ្នាំ 2026 មានសេចក្តីរាយការណ៍ពីការបង្កើនវត្តមានកងទ័ពជើងទឹកថៃ ការល្បាត និងសកម្មភាពយោធាថ្មីៗនៅក្នុងដែនទឹកជម្លោះ។ ការកើនឡើងកម្តៅនេះបានកើតឡើងបន្ទាប់ពីការប៉ះទង្គិចគ្នាតាមព្រំដែនកាលពីឆ្នាំ 2025 ដែលបង្កឱ្យមានការខូចខាត និងការជម្លៀសប្រជាជន ខណៈកម្ពុជាបង្ហាញការព្រួយបារម្ភចំពោះស្ថិរភាពក្នុងតំបន់ និងការមិនគោរពច្បាប់អន្តរជាតិ ក៏ដូចជាគោលការណ៍ UNCLOS ពីសំណាក់ភាគីថៃ។
title: Thailand Provokes New Military Activities After Revoking the 2001 MOU

summary: Following Thailand's decision to revoke the 2001 maritime agreement (MoU 44), Cambodia has announced it will initiate compulsory conciliation under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). Experts believe this legal strategy will help clarify positions and maintain stability despite the shift toward confrontation.

summaryTh: หลังจากไทยตัดสินใจยกเลิกบันทึกความเข้าใจปี 2544 (MoU 44) กัมพูชาประกาศว่าจะเริ่มกระบวนการไกล่เกลี่ยภาคบังคับภายใต้อนุสัญญาสหประชาชาติว่าด้วยกฎหมายทะเล (UNCLOS) ผู้เชี่ยวชาญมองว่ากลยุทธ์ทางกฎหมายนี้จะช่วยชี้แจงจุดยืนและรักษาเสถียรภาพ แม้ความสัมพันธ์จะเปลี่ยนไปสู่การเผชิญหน้ากันมากขึ้น
title: Experts back Cambodia's UNCLOS conciliation plan for overlapping maritime claims with Thailand

summary: The Cambodian government has urged Thailand to resume Joint Boundary Commission (JBC) talks following reports of a leadership reshuffle in Bangkok's negotiating team. Cambodia reaffirmed its commitment to peaceful demarcation based on historical maps and international legal principles, while rejecting any use of force to alter borders.

summary: Thai rangers stopped Cambodian villagers from farming in a disputed area in Sa Kaeo province. Thai authorities claimed the activity crossed into Thai territory, while Cambodian soldiers were present at the scene. Both sides reached an initial agreement to halt all activities in the disputed zone until the border can be clearly clarified.

summary: The Cambodian Ministry of National Defence has formally rejected claims by the Thai military that five gunshots were fired by Cambodian forces in the Phnom Bak area of Oddar Meanchey province earlier today. The ministry labeled the accusation as fabricated and intended to cause confusion, urging the Thai side to stop spreading such information.

summaryTh: กัมพูชากำลังพิจารณากระบวนการประนีประนอมภายใต้ UNCLOS เพื่อแก้ไขข้อพิพาทเขตแดนทางทะเลและปลดล็อกทรัพยากรพลังงานในพื้นที่ทับซ้อน เจ้าหน้าที่ระบุว่าฝ่ายไทยยกเลิกบันทึกความเข้าใจ (MOU) ปี 2001 ฝ่ายเดียว ซึ่งนำไปสู่การดำเนินการนี้

summary: Following reported gunfire near the border on May 24, Cambodia and Thailand are stepping up diplomatic efforts to de-escalate tensions. summaryKh: នាយករដ្ឋមន្ត្រីកម្ពុជាបានគូសបញ្ជាក់ថា បញ្ហាព្រំដែនកើតចេញពីក្រុមជាតិនិយមជ្រុលមួយចំនួនតូចដែលមិនដែលស្ថិតនៅលើសមរភូមិប្រយុទ្ធ ហើយលោកសង្ឃឹមថាវាជាមេរៀនសម្រាប់ប្រជាពលរដ្ឋទាំងពីរប្រទេស។
summaryTh: นายกรัฐมนตรีกัมพูชาระบุว่าปัญหาพรมแดนเกิดจากกลุ่มหัวรุนแรงกลุ่มเล็กๆ ซึ่งคนกลุ่มนี้ไม่เคยปรากฏตัวในสนามรบ ต่างจากทหารและประชาชนที่ได้รับผลกระทบจากความขัดแย้ง
title: Border issues stemming from small group of extremists, says PM
titleKh: បញ្ហាព្រំដែនកម្ពុជា-ថៃ កើតចេញពីក្រុមប្រឆាំងជ្រុលនិយមមួយចំនួនតូច
titleTh: นายกฯ กัมพูชาระบุ ปัญหาพรมแดนเกิดจากกลุ่มหัวรุนแรงเพียงเล็กน้อย

summary: The Cambodian government urges Thailand to respect the commitments made during the General Border Committee (GBC) meetings to restore mutual trust and maintain peace, specifically rejecting any border claims made through military force or unilateral action.
summaryKh: រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលកម្ពុជា បានអំពាវនាវឱ្យប្រទេសថៃគោរពតាមការប្តេជ្ញាចិត្តក្នុងកិច្ចប្រជុំគណៈកម្មាធិការព្រំដែនទូទៅ (GBC) ដើម្បីស្តារទំនុកចិត្តគ្នាទៅវិញទៅមក និងរក្សាសន្តិភាព ដោយបញ្ជាក់ថា កម្ពុជាមិនទទួលស្គាល់ការទាមទារទឹកដីតាមរយៈការប្រើប្រាស់កម្លាំងយោធា ឬការធ្វើសកម្មភាពឯកតោភាគីឡើយ។
summaryTh: รัฐบาลกัมพูชาเรียกร้องให้ไทยเคารพข้อตกลงจากคณะกรรมการชายแดนทั่วไป (GBC) เพื่อฟื้นฟูความเชื่อใจและรักษาความสงบ โดยเน้นย้ำว่าไม่ยอมรับการอ้างสิทธิ์เหนือดินแดนผ่านการใช้กำลังทหารหรือการกระทำฝ่ายเดียว
title: Cambodia does not recognize border lines through use of force or unilateral claims by Thailand
titleKh: កម្ពុជាមិនទទួលស្គាល់ខ្សែព្រំដែនតាមរយៈការប្រើប្រាស់កម្លាំង ឬការទាមទារទឹកដីជាឯកតោភាគីដោយប្រទេសថៃ
titleTh: กัมพูชาไม่ยอมรับเส้นเขตแดนที่เกิดจากการใช้กำลังหรือการอ้างสิทธิ์ฝ่ายเดียวโดยไทย

summary: The Cambodian government has officially protested against Thailand, accusing them of violating sovereignty by expanding military infrastructure in disputed border areas, which Cambodia claims violates the December 2025 ceasefire agreement. The protest highlights the construction of roads, large Buddha statues, and the installation of shipping containers and barbed wire by Thai forces.
summaryKh: រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលកម្ពុជាបានដាក់លិខិតតវ៉ាជាផ្លូវការប្រឆាំងនឹងប្រទេសថៃ ដោយចោទប្រកាន់ថាថៃបានរំលោភលើអធិបតេយ្យភាពតាមរយៈការសាងសង់សំណង់យោធានៅក្នុងតំបន់ព្រំដែនដែលមានជម្លោះ ដែលកម្ពុជាអះអាងថាជាការរំលោភលើកិច្ចព្រមព្រៀងបទឈប់បាញ់កាលពីខែធ្នូ ឆ្នាំ2025។ ការតវ៉ានេះផ្តោតលើការសាងសង់ផ្លូវ ព្រះពុទ្ធបដិមាធំៗ និងការដាក់កុងតឺន័រ និងបន្លាលួសដោយកងកម្លាំងថៃ។
summaryTh: รัฐบาลกัมพูชาประท้วงไทยอย่างเป็นทางการ โดยกล่าวหาว่าไทยละเมิดอธิปไตยด้วยการขยายโครงสร้างพื้นฐานทางทหารในพื้นที่ชายแดนพิพาท ซึ่งกัมพูชาอ้างว่าเป็นการละเมิดข้อตกลงหยุดยิงเมื่อเดือนธันวาคม 2025 โดยระบุถึงการสร้างถนน รูปปั้นพระพุทธรูปขนาดใหญ่ และการติดตั้งตู้คอนเทนเนอร์และลวดหนาม
title: Cambodia exposes Thai military expansion in disputed territory

titleTh: กัมพูชาแฉไทยขยายฐานทัพในพื้นที่พิพาท

summary: The Cambodian government has formally protested recent construction activities by Thailand in disputed border areas, calling for a resumption of joint boundary commission work and a halt to unilateral territorial claims.
summaryKh: រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលកម្ពុជា បានដាក់លិខិតតវ៉ាជាផ្លូវការចំពោះសកម្មភាពសាងសង់របស់ថៃនៅតំបន់ព្រំដែនដែលមានជម្លោះ ដោយទាមទារឱ្យមានការបន្តការងារគណៈកម្មការព្រំដែនរួម និងបញ្ឈប់ការទាមទារទឹកដីដោយឯកតោភាគី។
summaryTh: รัฐบาลกัมพูชาได้ยื่นประท้วงอย่างเป็นทางการต่อกิจกรรมการก่อสร้างของฝ่ายไทยในพื้นที่ชายแดนที่ยังเป็นข้อพิพาท โดยเรียกร้องให้มีการเดินหน้าการสำรวจและปักปันเขตแดนร่วมกัน
title: Cambodia protests Thai construction activities in occupied border areas
titleKh: កម្ពុជាធ្វើការតវ៉ាប្រឆាំងនឹងសកម្មភាពសាងសង់របស់ថៃនៅក្នុងតំបន់ព្រំដែនដែលត្រូវបានកាន់កាប់
titleTh: กัมพูชาประท้วงกิจกรรมการก่อสร้างของไทยในพื้นที่ชายแดนที่ถูกยึดครอง
